capabilities: Visualize every note as a plant that grows through five stages by word count and backlinks
Draw folders as moss islands grouped by folder, subfolder, tag, or type
Open notes by clicking plants, fuzzy search, or camera flight to the active note
Replay the vault's history as a creation-order timelapse
Customize plants, decorations, motion, colors, and per-note placement via settings and frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a gardening or journaling plugin; it is a read-only visualization that only maps the vault as a garden.
extras: The plugin is read-only and never modifies notes; it works on desktop and mobile and can be installed via BRAT before store listing.
problem: Obsidian's graph view is an abstract node diagram, with no calm, spatial overview of how notes have grown, been tended, or connected over time.

relations.evidence: Before it is listed: install BRAT and add racconrad/garden-zen.

summary: Isometric garden view that renders each note as a growing plant and each folder as an island, sized by words and links.
